name: inspect_rust_binary
description: Inspect the cargo-auditable crate dependency list embedded in an explicit local ELF, PE or thin Mach-O image. Returns the artifact SHA-256, the .dep-v0 section file offset and size, compressed and uncompressed sizes, format version, packages in their original order, the root package index, and dependency edges by index. Reads zlib-compressed JSON without installing Rust, opening a disassembler, executing the target, writing temporary files or accessing the network. A missing section is null metadata with a limitation and is not proof that the binary has no dependencies. A rustc commit hash is reported only as an inference when a /rustc/<40-hex>/ path is present in read-only data. Resource guards bound files to 256 MiB, dependency sections to 1 MiB, inflated JSON to the smaller of 8 MiB and 64 times the compressed size, and the complete report to 8 MiB. Malformed, unsupported and oversized inputs receive typed failures rather than partial success.
